column1: # Stage 2c label forms: chemistry (plans/synthetic.md "Text", hygiene; synthetic/forms.py).
# "written<TAB>conventional": a written form of a term and the conventional form the label uses. Matched
# case-insensitively on whole tokens, longest first. The two sides may differ only in letter case and in a hyphen
# versus a space, so the scorer's normalized words never change. ASCII only. Curated by hand (2026-10-24) from a
# review of the pilot's labels; doubtful items (ordinary-word senses, noun versus modifier uses) are left out.
